implementation.notifications: Actual SessionController resolves the saved originating session; idle/busy/cold followup uses a Flow source. Missing origins report errors; prompts do not impersonate users.
implementation.plugin: Named Cordis entry, actual service installation/disposal, skill-only agent-team command, defaults/catalog configuration and shared capacity. P5/P6 services/UI remain separate phases.

nativeEntryPermissionPolicy.kind: Implementation authorization boundary, separate from logical parent permission rule
nativeEntryPermissionPolicy.default: configured permission if provided, otherwise actual native session grant
nativeEntryPermissionPolicy.ceiling: maximum of actual native session grant and explicit trusted configured permission
nativeEntryPermissionPolicy.snapshot: Both captured at signed origin issue; model defaults never contribute to ceiling.
nativeEntryPermissionPolicy.limits: Does not impose a runtime privilege lock, change Core parent semantics, or add arbitrary preset/extras allowlists.
